title: MeshInstance3D.Skin.GetBindBone(  <int> ) always returns -1 even when the bone exists in the skeleton.
body: ### Tested versions - Reproduceable in Godot 4.7.x stable mono, Godot 4.6.x stable mono, Godot 4.5.x stable mono - Did not test before Godot 4.5.x stable mono ### System information OS - Windows 10, Godot Version - Godot 4.7.2 stable mono, GPU - NVDIA 2050 4GB, CPU - Intel i5 - 12450HX, RAM - 12GB DDR5 4800 MT/s ### Issue description This is more or less my first time opening an issue in github and also in a well known repository, so I apologize beforehand if I do something wrong and also I am not an native english speaker so mistakes might be present. Here is the following code used :- ```c# // Gamemanager.Log is same has GD.Print(); // WeaponModelsSkeletons[ 0 ] is skeleton 3D of the weapon GameManager.Log( "Bind Count = ", (WeaponModelsSkeletons[0].GetChildren()[3] as MeshInstance3D).Skin.GetBindCount() ); GameManager.Log( "Get Bind Bone Name= ", (WeaponModelsSkeletons[0].GetChildren()[3] as MeshInstance3D).Skin.GetBindName( 0 ) ); GameManager.Log( "Get Bind Bone Name= ", (WeaponModelsSkeletons[0].GetChildren()[3] as MeshInstance3D).Skin.GetBindName( 1 ) ); GameManager.Log( "Get Bind Bone = ", (WeaponModelsSkeletons[0].GetChildren()[3] as MeshInstance3D).Skin.GetBindBone( 0 ) ); // Doesnt work always returns -1 GameManager.Log( "Get Bind Bone = ", (WeaponModelsSkeletons[0].GetChildren()[3] as MeshInstance3D).Skin.GetBindBone( 1 ) ); // Doesnt work always returns -1 ``` Output( Images ) - Console Output Mesh of the model ( WeaponModelsSkeletons[0].GetChildren()[3] as MeshInstance3D ) Bind Bone names Function Parameter and return values But this part of code :- ```c# GameManager.Log( "Get Bind Bone = ", (WeaponModelsSkeletons[0].GetChildren()[3] as MeshInstance3D).Skin.GetBindBone( 0 ) ); // Doesnt work always returns -1 GameManager.Log( "Get Bind Bone = ", (WeaponModelsSkeletons[0].GetChildren()[3] as MeshInstance3D).Skin.GetBindBone( 1 ) ); // Doesnt work always returns -1 ``` always returns -1 which should not as the bones exist. It should return proper integer value in this case it would be:- 7 for ``tag_sight_on`` and 0 for ``j_gun`` Reference Images:- Did not test with GDScript but it should return the same result as this is related to the engine. ### Steps to reproduce I would not be able to share the assets as it is not mine but with it will be easy to reciprocate with the following steps:- - Creating a 3D model with a skeleton in a 3D software - Importing it in Godot and making a new scene and attcahing to a script - Inside the script get the mesh which has a bone attached to the skin - Call these functions to get the output on console ( Assuming your mesh has 2 bones binded ) ```c# GD.Print( "Bind Count = ", ExampleMesh3D.Skin.GetBindCount() ); GD.Print( "Get Bind Bone Name1 = ", ExampleMesh3D.Skin.GetBindName( 0 ) ); GD.Print( "Get Bind Bone Name2 = ", ExampleMesh3D.Skin.GetBindName( 1 ) ); GD.Print( "Get Bind Bone1 Index = ", ExampleMesh3D.Skin.GetBindBone( 0 ) ); // Should return the value it shows in Boneattachment3D Bone Index GD.Print( "Get Bind Bone = ", ExampleMesh3D.Skin.GetBindBone( 1 ) ); // Should return the value it shows in Boneattachment3D Bone Index ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
